title: Astro Portal planner document
description: The whole portable planner document persisted by the web client and by PUT /api/plans (packages/portal/src/planner/state.js:113-328). Structural invariants only: plan/night id uniqueness and the plan.nightId -> night.date cross-reference are enforced by validatePlannerDocument, not by this schema. The serialized document is rejected above 1 MB (1000000 bytes) by the API route; that bound is not expressible as a JSON Schema keyword.

darkness.description: The darkness threshold that bounds this plan's night: the Sun below -18° (`astronomical`), -12° (`nautical`) or -6° (`civil`). ABSENT means astronomical, the planner's own definition; a reader treats any other value as absent (packages/portal/src/planner/state.js `normalizePlanDarkness`).

nightSpan.description: The span of the night this plan keeps: the whole usable night of its `darkness` (`astronomical` mode), or a `custom` span between two UTC instants. ABSENT means `astronomical`. A reader normalises it once (packages/portal/src/planner/state.js `normalizeNightSpan`): an unknown value is dropped; a custom span is rounded to ten minutes, kept between the night's sunset and sunrise, and falls back to `astronomical` when it lasts less than thirty minutes. Shortening the night never deletes a target.

surveyedAt.description: The instant this 10° sector was last surveyed (augmented reality, or moved by hand); absent: « à relever ». Kept only on the 10° grid.

knownPlace.description: Additive: the link of a personal place to the known place it was added from. Normalised by state.js normalizeKnownPlaceLink; anything else is dropped. The details of the known place are read through GET /v1/places/known when shown, never stored here.

skyEntered.description: Additive: the sky background the observer typed for the place, in mag/arcsec² (a hand-held meter's reading), and when. Normalised by sky-brightness-source.js normalizeSkyEntered (`sqm` kept to the hundredth, 14 to 22.5); anything else is dropped. Shown when no value was measured at the place (measured > entered > model).

acquisitionLine.description: Additive (« Prise de vue par cible »): one acquisition line a person chose for a plan — the line of the captures' contract (capture.schema.json `proposedAcquisitionLine`) with the same names, units and bounds, plus `binning`, so that what was planned and what was measured compare field by field. Every field is OPTIONAL and an absent one is INHERITED (the target's line, then `item.filter` for the filter of the first line, then the plan's `acquisitionDefaults`, then the suggestion computed on reading — never stored). `filter`: the filter as the person names it (1 to 40 characters, trimmed, never normalised; its family is derived on reading), `null` for « no filter ». `exposureSeconds`: one exposure, in seconds (0.005 for 5 ms). `gain`: the camera's gain, or a camera body's ISO, as an integer; `null` for « the device's own setting ». `binning`: 1 to 8. `frameCount`: the number of exposures; absent lets the time slot decide. Written by the web planner and the mobile planner when the person chooses a value, never by a rule. A write that carries a value out of these bounds is refused `400` (`PUT /api/plans`: `code: "invalid_payload"`, `field` its path in the document, `plans[0].items[0].acquisition.lines[0].exposureSeconds`, and `limit`); a field the line does not define is dropped. Every reader (the service, packages/portal/src/planner/plan-acquisition.js `normalizePlanAcquisition`, and the clients) keeps what it understands and discards the rest.

acquisition.description: Additive: the acquisition lines of one target, 1 to 8 (one for a colour camera or a single filter; several for a mono camera, L, R, G, B or Hα, O III, or an alternation of filters). The first line's `filter`, when it is present, is copied into the item's `filter` by every writer and by the service (`null` as `""`), so that a reader that does not know `acquisition` — the iCalendar export, the printable sheet, an installed application of an earlier version — still shows the right filter: the first line wins.

launchedSchedule.description: The plan as it stood when its night was launched (additive): one entry per slotted item, in the order of the slots, with the minutes the item's `startMinute`/`endMinute` held at that instant, counted from the plan's night start. Written ONCE, by the mobile application's launch (`NightSessionController.launchPlan`, before any start of the launch is trimmed), and never rewritten: every surface that saves the plan keeps it as it is. `targetId` is the item's `targetId`, else the item's own `id` (the key the execution screen folds a target by). The execution screen draws every drift of the night against it (the frozen plan), the visual night draws it as its « Prévu » rail; a plan launched without it simply has no frozen reference. ABSENT before the launch.

acquisition.description: Additive: the EFFECTIVE acquisition lines of this item at the instant of the launch — the person's choices and the suggestion resolved, every field the launch knew written — frozen with the slot by the same launch (`NightSessionController.launchPlan`) and never rewritten: the debriefing compares what was measured to them, and a later change of the suggestion rule does not rewrite what was planned. ABSENT for a plan launched before it existed (its debriefing shows the measured lines alone).

ruleVersion.description: Additive: the version of the suggestion rule that resolved the frozen `acquisition`, written with it by the launch.

planItem.description: One planned target; open beyond `id`. `projectId` (additive) names the project — the multi-night plan — this interval works for: the link is carried by the interval, never by the plan. Every surface keeps it untouched through every write and read; a reader that does not know it shows a normal plan.

filter.description: The item's filter (`""` for none). When `acquisition.lines[0].filter` is present it is the same value (`""` for its `null`), copied by every writer and aligned by the service.

acquisition.description: Additive: the acquisition lines the person chose for this target, written by the web planner and the mobile planner; absent while nothing was chosen (every value then comes from the plan's `acquisitionDefaults`, else the suggestion). « Revenir aux suggestions » removes it. Shown and proposed in photography mode only; kept as it is in visual mode. Needs no capability.

mode.description: The horizon map's mode: every target at one instant (positions) or the whole night of one chosen target (path). Absent means positions.

pathTargetId.description: The target whose night the path mode draws; null lets the map choose (the selected target, else the plan's first).

layers.description: The horizon map's layers: the place's horizon mask and the estimated light pollution by direction. Absent means mask on, light pollution off. Only the switches are stored: the light-pollution grid is derived data, never written into the plan.

archivedFrom.description: Additive, read-only: the state an archived plan had before its archive (`executed`, `partial` or `abandoned`), served on an archived plan of a closed night and absent otherwise; the service decides it, a copy that carries another value does not change it.

equipment.description: The plan's equipment selection. Open object. `windTolerance` (optional): `{ preset: "light" | "standard" | "heavy" | "custom", sustainedKmh, gustKmh }`, the wind and gust limits of the plan's mount in km/h (presets 15/25, 20/30, 30/45; custom 5 to 80), copied from the device or browser setting of that mount into the plans that can still take it; absent reads as standard.

acquisitionDefaults.description: Additive: the plan's defaults — the line the person chose for the whole night (exposure, gain, filter; binning and frame count under « Plus de réglages »), written by the web planner and the mobile planner; a field chosen here holds for every target that does not choose its own, a field left absent stays suggested target by target. ABSENT while nothing was chosen; a reader removes an empty one.
